premises.text: Online merchants need flexible custom currency (gift cards, promos, refund credits) but payment systems make building tracking, controls, and associations hard, so mid-market shops must build it themselves
premises.evidence_span: enabling custom currency is actually really hard to do

premises.text: A SaaS web app and API lets merchants create, distribute, control, and track custom currency integrated into checkout for developers and marketers
premises.evidence_span: a software as a service platform to solve this problem

premises.text: Pricing starts at $90/month for 1,000 active codes with usage-based steps, plus checkout integrations such as Shopify Plus and planned Stripe/Braintree
premises.evidence_span: We've priced our product starting at $90 a month to make it accessible to businesses of any size

value.text: Online businesses can run targeted custom-currency marketing without building the infrastructure themselves
value.evidence_span: no one needs to build their own complicated custom currency because they have GiftBit

causal_links.evidence_span: you're stuck building your own custom currency solution yourself
enable a business to have, distribute, and manage their own custom currency
accessible to businesses of any size

notes: Code tracking, spend controls, and gift/promo association difficulties folded as one custom-currency problem (v1.5.1 §4.1.6). Demo create-order/admin/consumer-reminder flows folded as feature cascade of the SaaS platform (§4.1.7). Prior gift-card reselling and beta logos excluded as credentials/traction. Price tiers and payment integrations as one commercial/GTM module. Anti-template: problem, product, and packaging separately revisable.
